entities.summary: Sahar Ansari, TI is an Urdu poet and linguist from Karachi, Pakistan. He remained associated with the University of Karachi as Professor and Chairman of Urdu department. Sahar Ansari was a writers & intellectuals from Aurangabad (b. 1939-12-27, Aurangabad). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
